semantics.asked: path or asked-nothing=1; failed, timeout, unsupported=0; missing excluded from metrics.
semantics.asymmetry: Disjoint categories; not_both_asked takes precedence over path asymmetry.
semantics.flags: Best of both directions, >=0.70 with >=10 pairs for pair accuracy or >=10 rows for AUC.
semantics.limits: Exploratory associations, not proof of leakage; running input snapshot, no multiple-testing correction.
semantics.missing: Coverage only; absent source metadata is unknown. Skipped result units are never consumed.
semantics.non_path: Observed non-path rows score zero; path rows lacking trace evidence have null trace features.
semantics.signals: Shortest nonempty trace (first on ties); its sanitizer, guard and corresponding witness sink call target.
semantics.sink_kind: One binary indicator per observed call target, including no-path/unknown; no ordinal encoding.
